newsitem.title: DUBAI: Perry leaves Saudi Arabia after talks.
newsitem.headline: Perry leaves Saudi Arabia after talks.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry, on a Gulf mission to secure support for a possible U.S. military showdown with Iraq, left Saudi Arabia early on Monday after holding talks with King Fahd, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) reported.
The agency did not say where he was headed.
Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah and Defence Minister Prince Sultan and other senior officials were also present in the meeting between Perry and King Fahd in Jeddah on Sunday.

Diplomats say Saudi Arabia, Washington's most powerful Gulf ally and with Kuwait and Bahrain one of three countries visited by Perry, was unlikely to back more missile attacks against Iraq or give open approval for a continuing American military buildup in the oil-rich region.
